_note: JSON has no comments -- the _ keys are the notes. The plugin ignores them. Read at server start only.
_raceAdmins: Race admins by BeamMP name. Unusable while BeamMP login is broken.
_racePassword: Anyone who types /raceui and enters this is a race admin until he disconnects. EMPTY = EVERY player may start races, overwrite grids and run the championship.
